\tjwt, err := jose.ParseSigned(token)\n314. \tif err != nil {\n315. \t\treturn nil, nil, errs.UnauthorizedErr(err, errs.WithMessage(\"failed to parse token\"))\n316. \t}\n317. \n318. \t// Extract Nebula certificate\n319. \th, ok := jwt.Headers[0].ExtraHeaders[NebulaCertHeader]\n320. \tif !ok {\n321. \t\treturn nil, nil, errs.Unauthorized(\"failed to parse token: nebula header is missing\")\n322. \t}\n323. \ts, ok := h.(string)\n324. \tif !ok {\n325. \t\treturn nil, nil, errs.Unauthorized(\"failed to parse token: nebula header is not valid\")\n326. \t}\n327. \tb, err := base64.StdEncoding.DecodeString(s)\n328. \tif err != nil {\n329. \t\treturn nil, nil, errs.UnauthorizedErr(err, errs.WithMessage(\"failed to parse token: nebula header is not valid\"))\n330. \t}\n331. not valid\"))\n334. \t}\n335. \n336. \t// Validate nebula certificate against CAs\n337. \tif valid, err := c.Verify(now(), p.caPool); !valid {\n338. \t\tif err != nil {\n339. \t\t\treturn nil, nil, failed to verify certificate against configured CA\")\n342. \t}\n343. \n344. \tvar pub any\n345. \tswitch {\n346. \tcase c.Details.Curve == nebula.Curve_P256:\n347. \t\t// When Nebula is used with *ecdsa.PublicKey, because our jose package nor go-jose supports *ecdh.PublicKey\n354. \t\t\tCurve: elliptic.P256(),\n355. \t\t\tX:     big.NewInt(0).SetBytes(publicKeyBytes[1:33]),\n356. \t\t\tY:     big.NewInt(0).SetBytes(publicKeyBytes[33:]),\n357. \t\t}\n358. \tcase c.Details.IsCA:\n359. \t\tpub = ed25519.PublicKey(c.Details.PublicKey)\n360. \tdefault:\n361. \t\tpub = {\n376. \t\treturn nil, nil, errs.UnauthorizedErr(err, errs.WithMessage(\"token is not valid: invalid claims\"))\n377. \t}\n378. \n379. \t// Validate token and subject too.\n380. \tif
